title: docs(pm-dispatch): for a p1 card-thread card the L1 thread starts the isolated L2 beside its L1; a dispatch order missing its derivation is sent back (#35813)

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #35813
Part of #35905 (its item 2 and the `os-dev.md` mirror land here; items 1 and 3, the two project-memory lines for `references/project-forms.md`, are carried on branch `claude/issue-35905-project-forms-lines`, see "Not in this PR")

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: 7035727071 — the maintainer's words 「已经决定了，不是试 3 张 p1 卡，是所有 p1 都按照新规则执行」, seat thread, 2026-11-20T09:22:50Z, for the p1 hand-back lines; 7046610679 — the maintainer's answer 「同意，立卡派发」, cost-review thread, 2026-11-20T09:07:52Z, to 「如果确保协调者严格按照技能执行，之前有犯错，协调者用了项目记忆」, for the missing-derivation line and its mirror; each transcribed as the ruling record on its card

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感;车队内部:p1 卡由卡线程交回后,审核线程做普通审核的同时就起独立的契约审核,两份意见一起回到座位,不再一前一后各等一轮;派发令缺少档位或投入度的推导时,接令的线程或分区不开工并退回座位。
- 为什么做:你裁定所有 p1 卡都按精简流程走,并同意把「协调者严格照技能执行、不凭项目记忆」写进技能;这里是照这两条裁决抄写的规则文字。
- 出错会怎样:只影响车队内部的审核路由与派发文字,最坏是一张 p1 卡的两级审核仍然一前一后,或一张派发令被多退回一次,随时可整段撤回。
- 要你做什么:无;另有两条关于项目记忆的规则因所在文件的字节上限已满没有写进这次改动,座位会另行向你呈报。

## What changes

Four governed files under `.claude/`, internal only (nothing publishes). Every added line copies one of the two rulings above; every deleted fragment is a restatement whose fact keeps a home elsewhere (cut list below). No ceiling row moves.

**The p1 hand-back path (ruling record 7035727071)**

1. `references/contract-review.md`, who runs L2. New line under the existing `谁跑 = 派发席` line:
   - `` - p1 卡线程卡交回且欠 L2 ⇒ L1 线程起隔离 L2 子代理,与其 L1 并行,两份意见同回席。 ``
2. `references/contract-review.md`, the adoption line. The seat adopts the L1 thread's sub-agent record exactly as it adopts a card thread's, so the brief, the `Scope:` check, the independence pair and the tier evidence read as before.
   - Before: `` - 卡线程隔离子代理照上落现 head 记录并贴简报 ⇒ 席核简报、… ``
   - After: `` - 卡线程或 L1 线程隔离子代理照上落现 head 记录并贴简报 ⇒ 席核简报、… ``
3. `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, card-thread section, the roles line: the thread builds itself.
   - Before: `` …;线程实施、开 draft PR、驱动 CI 与可合并。 ``
   - After: `` …;线程自己实施、开 draft PR、驱动 CI 与可合并,⛔ 不起 `os-dev` 子代理。 ``
4. `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, card-thread section, the same hand-back path in one line, directly under the roles line:
   - `` - p1 卡交回且欠 L2 ⇒ L1 线程并行起 L1 与隔离 L2(`contract-review.md`),两份意见同回席。 ``
5. `references/area-lease.md`, the L1 thread lines of 〈分不分区,动态定〉. This is where the L1 thread's duties live: there is no `lanes/l1-review.md`, and `l1-review-checklist.md` holds the L1 criteria, not who starts what. New line:
   - `` - p1 卡线程卡交回且欠 L2 ⇒ L1 线程并行起隔离 L2 子代理(`contract-review.md`)。 ``

**A dispatch order missing its derivation (ruling record 7046610679, item 2 of that card)**

6. `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, card-thread section, new line under the line that says the order carries the tier, the effort and their derivation:
   - `` - 线程或区见令缺推导 ⇒ 不开工,退回席位;⛔ 不凭记忆补档位。 ``
7. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, 〈何时停手不写码〉, the mirror a card thread reads, scoped to the ruled subject (a card thread or an area), so an ordinary sub-agent or cloud dev is not bound by it:
   - `` - 卡线程或区:派发令缺档位或 effort 的推导 ⇒ 不开工,退回席位;⛔ 不凭记忆补档位。 ``

The charter pointer: SKILL.md lane table, `l2-review` row; the routing line of the same section (``请谁照 `lanes/l2-review.md` ``). Scripts cite the heading as 〈L2 归属与资格〉, which still matches |

## Not in this PR

Items 1 and 3 of the second card (the two project-memory lines for `references/project-forms.md`) are not here: that file is at headroom 0 and is untouched by this PR. The seat carries that half on branch `claude/issue-35905-project-forms-lines`, under its reading on that card (record 7071003039).

## Tests

Text-only change to four internal instruction files; no package and no test target. Gates below.

## Acceptance notes

- No changeset: `.claude/**` is on the fast path of files that publish nothing; `skip-changeset` rides this create.
- `.claude/**` is governed. This PR stays draft for the seat's contract-review record at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which must read `Rule-change-verified: ruled`. The dev knocks nobody.
- "Brief still posted": the brief, the independence pair and the tier evidence are carried by extending the existing adoption line to the L1 thread's sub-agent, so they are the same sentences as before. That line's wording `落现 head 记录并贴简报` is not reordered; the brief template itself says the brief is posted beside the record for the seat to read before it adopts.
- "No `os-dev` sub-agent" is written for every card thread, not only p1: the section already calls the card thread the dev (`coordinator 调度卡线程(即 dev)`, `线程实施`), so the clause states what the section meant, and the ruling orders it for p1.
- The hand-back line sits under the roles line, not under the `交回:` line, because open draft PR #36205 inserts two lines at that point; `overlap-check` now reads clean against it. That PR also adds bytes to `dispatch-runbook.md`, which lands here at headroom 2, so whichever lands second pays again.
- The tool text printed by `record-recognisers.mjs --brief-template` names a card thread as the one handing the brief to its isolated sub-agent; it does not yet name the L1 thread. Noted, not changed: scripts are outside this card's file surface.
- Base: the branch was cut at `cbd582f4` (the dispatch order named `fa304140`; `origin/main` had moved). `git diff --stat fa304140 cbd582f4 -- .claude scripts/pm` is empty, and so is the same reading from the branch base to `origin/main` at `1d060265`, so no merge of `main` was taken before opening.
- Fix round 1 (review record 7071038753, S1): the `os-dev.md` mirror line named no subject and so read as binding every dev that reads the file; it now names the ruled subject, 16 bytes inside that file's headroom. No other text changed. `origin/main` at `99fbaa6d` had moved `area-lease.md` and the ratchet table, so `main` was merged (clean) before the push; the four files measure the same after the merge and no ceiling row of theirs moved.

## Verification

First files to read, by risk:

1. `references/contract-review.md`: the new p1 line under `谁跑`, the adoption line, and the two cut hunks at the top of the file (the heading and the prose-face sentence).
2. `references/dispatch-runbook.md`, card-thread section: the derivation pair (cut 7 and the new line under it), the roles line and the hand-back line.
3. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` 〈何时停手不写码〉: the mirror line.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs | grep -E 'contract-review|dispatch-runbook|area-lease|os-dev' | grep ceiling` prints the four files at 20068, 6418, 6584 and 38846 bytes under ceilings 20070, 6419, 6586 and 38848, every line ticked.
